title: The cross-department refusal
subtitle: A real doctor with a real login, and Orb still says no

steps.caption: New chat. This login is General Medicine; cardiology is not its ward.
Ask for the potassium result of the patient in cardiology bed C-201.

No result. The cardiology chart is outside this login's scope, so Sage is never shown it. Scoping is enforced in the server, not hidden in the UI: a direct API call for that chart returns 404, as if the patient were not there at all.
